evidence: Line-by-line walk of instruction.md + hireops_rules.md against the frozen reference; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. VIEWS: staff get Board/Conversations/Activity (app.js:87-91 buildViews), candidates get 'My applications' list+conversation (app.js:89, threads.js:27,52-53,138-139) with job title, team and candidate wording from seed (index.js:171-176, LABELS). Sign-in/out and seeded accounts (index.js:84-101, db.js:61-66). ROLES/401/403/404: auth() (index.js:73-81), candidate 404 for others' apps (index.js:121-131), observer read-only (board.js:9 canWrite, 137-138; threads.js:140-142), HM own-job + Interview/Offer/Hired limits (index.js:257-263, 117; board.js:153-161). JOBS/CANDIDATES: open job recruiter-only with HM select and 1-50 places (index.js:202-214, board.js:61-81); add candidate at bottom of Applied, email format + case-insensitive per-job duplicate refused with field marking and typed values kept (index.js:216-233, board.js:47-56), candidate-account linkage (index.js:225). BOARD: six stages, one-stage-at-a-time, reject with non-blank reason remembers origin, reopen only to origin clears reason, Hired not rejectable (index.js:238-264, 311-313); non-drag Move select + Up/Down reorder (board.js:215-241) plus HTML5 drag with drop-before placement (board.js:242,300-319); shared persisted order (positions in SQLite, writeColumn index.js:199-200); Interview capacity incl. reorder always allowed and freed place reusable (index.js:289-294); version 409 conflict naming the actor via last activity line (index.js:241-245); optimistic move + put back + reason + focus on card controls (board.js:166-205); bulk all-or-nothing in board order with capacity counted for the set (index.js:273-320, 327-331; board.js:277-290); undo own latest move single or bulk, restores stage/place/reason, refused if any card changed or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by later move (index.js:165-168, 335-360; board.js:291-299). NOTES: card detail with notes, role-scoped writing, per-person per-browser unsaved note draft (index.js:363-373; board.js:85-141). ACTIVITY: job opened/added/moved/rejected(with reason)/reopened/reordered/undone as readable lines, newest first, all jobs or one job filter, append-only (index.js:195-198,265-270,353; app.js:45-85). LIVE: SSE 'changed' on every successful write incl. read marks (index.js:45-54,102-107; app.js:130-164) with in-place keyed patching preserving open card, note draft, focus, scroll (board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65,145-159). CONVERSATIONS: per-role access (index.js:114-120), latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count and scroll anchoring (index.js:384-391; threads.js:110-131,160-175), Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline / cleared and focused after send / failed text kept (threads.js:183-201), line breaks kept (styles.css:105 pre-wrap), per-person unread counts with own messages excluded and send counting as read, per-conversation and total badge (index.js:132-139,399-400; threads.js:222; app.js:115-121), new-message pill while scrolled up without marking read (threads.js:145-159,176-181), Seen receipt with observer excluded (index.js:143-150; threads.js:76-83). DRAFTS: localStorage keyed by user id + conversation, survive switch/reload/session end, re-login restores, other users see none, cleared on send (app.js:38-43,187-195; threads.js:112,124,182,196). RUNTIME: node /app/server.js, PORT honoured, health answered before DB (bootstrap.js:18-24,43), DB_PATH honoured, seed copied beside module and loaded once (db.js:9-10,61-62), solve.sh copies app to /app. ACTUAL-RUN SUPPORT: hash-verified scripted golden observations (results/workspace.json, 18 groups all passed=true, page_errors []) exercise transitions, capacity, stale conflict naming actor, roles, undo, bulk, candidate privacy, paging, unread/seen, page-level board/bulk/undo, live board (arrival_ms 808), conversation paging/arrival, drafts, session-end draft recovery, observer, restart persistence. Not exercised by that script: drag-and-drop itself and the Activity per-job filter (source-only evidence; both present, board.js:242,300-319; app.js:47-83). Scripted observations are not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score, none of which is claimed here. Out-of-scope observations (not coverage gaps, for other rows): HM may reorder Rejected cards whose origin was Interview/Offer (index.js:259-262) which hireops_rules.md:70-72 does not explicitly grant; message timestamps and created_at use wall clock (index.js:59), relevant to row 20 not to deliverable coverage. Broken-app probe: an app missing any of these deliverables (e.g. no undo or no candidate view) would be a coverage gap; the reference has none. Conforming-alternative probe: polling instead of SSE, or server-side drafts, would equally satisfy the brief; reference choice does not narrow the ask.
